Episode Notes:
Jay sits down with John Fowler, who retired last year as a senior special agent at the Naval Criminal Investigative Service after 18 years. Fowler traces a dual-track national security career that ran from carrier deployments and human intelligence work in the Middle East to the counterintelligence and counterterrorism cases that rarely surface publicly.
